lede: The item worth watching this week is the Telluride Ecology Commission's November 4 meeting, where a draft ordinance to phase out gas-powered lawn and garden equipment — leaf blowers banned by 2028, everything else by 2030 — gets its first real public airing. On the land-use side, the P&Z Chair takes up a lot consolidation on West Columbia Avenue Monday. Bookending the week is a full Halloween weekend, plus Mountainfilm for Locals running Monday and Tuesday.

notable.stake: Draft ordinance would ban gas lawn equipment town-wide by 2028–2030.
Vote on merging two lots at 510 W Columbia Ave into one parcel.
